name: Tripartite Cycle-Cover Matrix Disguise
description: Replaces the three independent Vandermonde matrices with a single 3k x 3k matrix B. For each chosen configuration (x, y, z), we add 1 to B at (x, k+y), (k+y, 2k+z), and (2k+z, x). The determinant of B is non-zero if and only if x, y, and z are all permutations of 1..k. If any is not a permutation, some row remains all zeros (det=0). If they are permutations, B becomes a permutation matrix (det=\pm 1). This forces the model to reason about global matrix sparsity and cycle covers rather than applying row-wise identical-element logic.
